Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (Noble Numbat) base image

The MemoChat service container images are built FROM ubuntu:24.04. The
Ubuntu base image bundles packages published by Canonical and upstream
project maintainers under a variety of open-source licenses.

Primary license categories present in the Ubuntu 24.04 minimal base:
  GPL-2.0   — Linux kernel interfaces (glibc, procps, util-linux)
  LGPL-2.1  — GNU C Library (glibc), libgcc, libstdc++
  MIT       — ca-certificates, curl dependencies
  ISC       — OpenSSL helper libraries
  BSD-2/3   — Various system utilities
  Apache-2.0 — Some Canonical-owned tooling

The complete per-package copyright notices are embedded in the image at
  /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright
as required by the Debian Policy Manual.

Canonical Ubuntu project: https://ubuntu.com/
Ubuntu packages source:   https://launchpad.net/ubuntu
Debian policy (copyright): https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ch-docs.html#s-copyrightfile

Relevant top-level packages included in the minimal runtime layer:
  libc6, libgcc-s1, libstdc++6, zlib1g, libssl3, ca-certificates,
  libcurl4, libpq5, libmongoc-1.0-0, openssl

All packages are obtained unmodified from the official Ubuntu 24.04
package archive (archive.ubuntu.com / security.ubuntu.com).
